title: Waking Mind
summary: Trade a stored mind for Advantage on Intelligence saving throws.

fields.Use: Insert Waking Mind in the Mind-Archive Interface and speak to the Slack-Skinned Head. Choose the Illithid Persuasion option to purge or consume the mind.
fields.Githzerai Mind Barrier: Advantage on Intelligence saving throws. Persists through rests, but character death removes it even if you are Revivified.
fields.Acquisition: Solve the brain mapping puzzle in the Necrotic Laboratory in the Mind Flayer Colony. Find the mind at X 750, Y −139.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
